turns.doctor_question: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, doctor. It's really good to meet you, too. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Um... well, I hope I'm explaining this right, but... I guess I've just been feeling kind of like I'm constantly running on a motor lately? I mean, I like to stay productive, which is normally a good thing, right? But I'll finish one thing at school—I teach special education—or I'll finish a task at home, and I just... I immediately jump right into the next thing. It's like I can't ever really shut myself off. 

I really don't want to sound like I'm complaining, because I love my job and my life, I just... I want to make sure I'm doing my best for my students and not wearing people out. Does that make sense? I hope that's the kind of information you were looking for.
